name: Davydd
text: Davydd is a variant spelling of the Welsh name Dafydd. The dictionary routes this form to that main record. Dafydd is among the most common Welsh men's names, and the saint behind it is Dewi Sant. Readers should follow the Dafydd entry for the fuller account.
